summary: Xos, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) to update the amount of common stock it may sell under an existing at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program with Roth Capital Partners. The filing discloses that, as of June 5, 2026, the public float was about $59.96 million based on 8.04 million shares held by non-affiliates at $7.46 per share. No specific new offering terms (price, number of shares, expected proceeds) are provided; the supplement merely adjusts the available capacity under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3. This is a routine shelf takedown update, not a special situation.
